title: General likes, missing features, and isolated notices
summary: This topic mixes broad expressions of satisfaction with isolated mentions of missing items, recall notice, noise, and comparison-shopping remarks, with most fragments too vague to classify clearly.

positive.summary: Positive reviews mention noticing more things to like and being happy with everything else overall.

negative.summary: Negative feedback centers on concern that more features or items may have disappeared or gone missing.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments are brief or ambiguous remarks about comparisons, recall notice, noise not being bothersome, and unclear references to what else was available or missing.

limitations: Most fragments are very short or lack context, so sentiment and specific vehicle aspects are often unclear.
The cluster mixes unrelated subjects such as general praise, missing items, recall notice, noise, and shopping comparisons, so it is not a single coherent issue.
Examples are insufficient to determine the exact feature or component being discussed in several fragments.
